key_insight: Adaptive LLM routing can match or outperform any single model in automated heuristic discovery; larger, costlier models are not consistently better.
engineering_relevance: Ballad offers a way to improve heuristic search while reducing API spending by selecting models according to their evolving contribution.
method: Use an online bandit policy that favors rare, high-scoring heuristics over stable average performance.
Propagate credit through a DAG representing the heuristic population’s genealogy.
Discount stale observations to track each model’s current utility.
evidence_signal: Across five NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems and four LLMs, Ballad matched the best individual model in hindsight, sometimes surpassed all individual models, and reduced API cost by up to 65.6% versus always using the strongest model.
watch_item: Results cover only five problems and four models; effectiveness and savings may change with the model pool, pricing, and search setting.
paper_title: Ballad: Bandit-Based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery
